high: seek out places where nature has the last word
measure a place by how much life is going on around it
low: are most at ease where people have finished the job
don't need nature around you to feel well

high: prefer materials that live and change
like surfaces that carry the marks of time
low: like clean, stable surfaces that stay put
are drawn to the synthetic and the predictable

high: belong somewhere within reach of a field or a wood
count distance from the nearest neighbour as a feature
low: need something larger than a village around you
want things within easy reach

high: come alive in cities and movement
read a city the way other people read a landscape
low: get little out of the pace of a city
steer away from places where everyone is

high: are genuinely curious about how machines work
count technology as part of what can be beautiful
low: keep technology at arm's length
trust what doesn't need power most

high: have a real relationship with what happens on a screen
remember digital rooms as well as physical ones
low: want things in your hands, not in an app
feel the digital takes more than it gives

high: look ahead rather than back
like the thought that everything could be different
low: have little faith that new means better
look for answers in what already exists

high: find beauty in things built for work
like steel, concrete and visible structure
low: steer clear of the hard and mechanical
want softness where others accept steel

high: choose places with a past over places without one
read buildings and objects as stories
low: don't feel bound by what came before
live in the present without missing anything

high: carry a longing for something that was
are moved by traces of earlier lives, including other people's
low: see little point in missing the old
throw things out without sentiment

high: are drawn to the look of decades before your own
like things that are plainly dated
low: want things to look like their own time
have little patience for copies of the old

high: value custom and continuity
like that something is done because it always has been
low: are barely bound by how things are usually done
would rather find your own way than inherit one

high: like the new, the clean and the well-working
want things that don't carry someone else's wear
low: want patina rather than perfection
avoid what is too new and too smooth

high: like it best when something stays unexplained
are pulled towards the half-hidden
low: want answers rather than atmosphere
are little drawn to the enigmatic

high: keep one foot in worlds that don't exist
think in images rather than in facts
low: stay with what actually is
have little need for invented worlds

high: want things that are real over things that are pretty
value function and truth
low: let atmosphere outweigh sobriety
would rather have the beautiful than the correct

high: find something good in the heavy-hearted
like beauty with sorrow in it
low: keep away from the heavy
are drawn to the light and the easy

high: fundamentally believe things turn out well
have a bright baseline
low: hold few illusions about where this is heading
see the shadows before you see the light

high: are at home in low light and long shadows
like darkness as atmosphere, not as threat
low: need light around you
avoid the gloomy

high: have kept a playfulness that doesn't go out of fashion
like the strange and the unpredictable
low: take things seriously
have little patience for the silly

high: draw energy from other people
want people around you
low: are drained by too much company
need fewer people than most

high: want to belong to something larger than yourself

low: manage perfectly well without a collective
keep a little outside the group

high: need time alone to feel whole
have learned to enjoy your own company
low: rarely seek solitude
would rather have someone in the room

high: would rather stand out than fit in
want to decide for yourself, even when it costs
low: have little need to mark yourself out
are comfortable doing as others do

high: find calm in systems and repetition
want things to have their place
low: live perfectly well with disorder

high: work best when things are allowed to be a bit messy

setting.text: and it sits far enough out that nobody passes by
and there is always somebody there — the place only works with people in it
in the middle of something that still has traffic and light all night
preferably in grey weather, when the colours fall in on each other
and you rarely stay long enough to put down roots
with something warm within reach the whole time

architecture.text: though in your version everything stands straight and square
in your version it is extended, patched and never quite finished
and you notice every detail — how the roof meets the wall, where the light gets in
and the building was something else before it was yours
stripped back to the fewest parts that will do
with detail nobody paid for, but that you would have wanted anyway

interior.text: and every surface is covered in something you have collected
with few things, none of them accidental
and half of it is inherited or found
and you made or mended several of them yourself
lit from low lamps, never from the ceiling
and everything is chosen so people can stay sitting

technology.text: and you understand how it works, not just how to use it
and you keep it to a minimum
with at least one screen always on in the background
and the screens lie face down
and what you own, you can repair
and you want the newest version before it is finished

clothes.text: and the clothes say plainly that this is you
but with nothing that asks for attention
always a notch more considered than the occasion asks for
and it has to take hard wear
and nothing you cannot sit in for hours
with at least one detail there purely because it is nice

music.text: mostly in a minor key, and usually for a little too long
and preferably something with lift in it
and best of all with other people in the room
off a format older than it needs to be
and it can happily be uneven and badly recorded

colours.text: but several shades darker than the standard version
in a lighter version than people expect
and all of them at once
though only two of them — the rest stays neutral
always with earth or plant underneath
with one completely unreasonable colour allowed in

everyday.text: and all of this happens without an audience
and most of it is done alongside somebody
at roughly the same time every day
with no particular plan, which is the whole point
with a book or a question left open the whole time
interrupted by you suddenly going somewhere
